sources.snippet: Awards News TOY OF THE YEAR (TOTY) AWARDS AWARDS"). # The Toy Foundation Reveals 2025 TOTY Award Finalists. The Toy Foundation is hosting the 25th annual Toy of the Year (TOTY) Awards fundraiser on Feb. 28, and it just released its star-studded finalists list. Often hailed as “the Oscars of the toy industry,” the TOTY Awards celebrate the innovative toys, games, and collectibles that impress consumers and professionals alike. From a doll hidden behind a magic mirror to a sound-sensing robot, the 2025 TOTY Awards finalists represent dozens of toys that revolutionized the industry with their creativity and invention. > This year’s TOTY finalists exemplify our industry’s talent for delivering joy, encouraging exploration, and enhancing learning through the power of play. From now until Jan. 10, play-lovers of all ages can vote online for their favorite toys in each category to determine the 2025 TOTY Winners. The category winners, alongside the coveted overall Toy of the Year Award and consumer-chosen People’s Choice Award, will be announced live at the TOTY Awards Gala in February. The TOTY Awards Gala is a key fundraising event for the Toy Foundation’s year-round philanthropic work supporting kids in need. The TOTY Awards gala also kicks off Toy Fair 2025. All of the finalists will be honored in a commemorative issue of The Toy Book, set to land in mailboxes later this month! **The Toy Foundation’s 2025 Toy of The Year Award Finalists**. * Godzilla x Kong” The New Empire 13-inch Mega Figures by Playmates Toys. * Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Pet to Ninja Deluxe Figures by Playmates Toys. * Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game by Ravensburger North America. **CONSTRUCTION TOY/PLAYSET OF THE YEAR**. * Miraculous Paris Heroez Playset by Playmates Toys. **CREATIVE TOY OF THE YEAR**. **EDUCATIONAL TOY OF THE YEAR**. * Chronicles of Light: Darkness Falls (Disney Edition) by Ravensburger North America. **GROWN-UP TOY OF THE YEAR**. **INFANT/TODDLER TOY OF THE YEAR**. **OUTDOOR TOY OF THE YEAR**. **PLUSH TOY OF THE YEAR**. * Little Live Pets My Baby Monkey by Moose Toys. **PRESCHOOL TOY OF THE YEAR**. **SPECIALTY TOY OF THE YEAR**. **TECH TOY OF THE YEAR**. * Kids Clean Car by Henry’s Toy Box.

Title: The Toy Foundation™ Announces 2025 Toy of the Year® (TOTY®) Award Finalists
toy of the year 2025 logo. ## The Toy Foundation™ Announces 2025 Toy of the Year® (TOTY®) Award Finalists. **NEW YORK, NY | November 7, 2024 –** From a doll hidden behind a magic mirror to a sound-sensing robot, to dozens of toys that innovate beloved play patterns, the 2025 Toy of the Year® (TOTY®) Award finalists, announced today by The Toy Foundation™ (TTF), represent the most sought-out toys just in time for the holiday season. Known as the “Oscars of the toy industry,” the TOTY Awards celebrate the creativity of the global toy community and serves as a key fundraiser for TTF’s year-round philanthropic work supporting children in need. Between now and January 10, 2025, play-lovers of all ages can visit ToyAwards.org to vote for their favorite playthings in each of the 16 categories, browse toys, and make shopping lists for the holidays. Winners in each category, as well as the coveted overall Toy of the Year winner and the People’s Choice winner (based solely on consumer votes), will be announced at the TOTY Awards gala on Friday, February 28, 2025, at Cipriani 42nd Street in New York City. All event proceeds (including TOTY nomination fees) benefit TTF’s initiatives, including the Children’s Hospital Play Grants program to bring the healing power of play to children in hospital settings; Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion program to reach all communities with play; and The Toy Bank program to deliver the comfort and security of a toy to children in need around the world. The TOTY celebration will spotlight each of these program areas and the impact of bringing the benefits of play to children in need, as well as serve as an opportunity to donate and further its mission. “This year’s TOTY finalists exemplify our industry’s talent for delivering joy, encouraging exploration, and enhancing learning through the power of play,” said Pam Mastrota, executive director of The Toy Foundation. “We are proud to not only celebrate these innovative playthings but also the philanthropic impact fundraising for the TOTY Awards celebration will have in supporting the physical and emotional wellbeing of children in need around the world. **EDUCATIONAL TOY OF THE YEAR**.

Title: Fidget toy made in Greenville wins 2025 Toy of the Year award
# Fidget toy made in Greenville wins 2025 Toy of the Year award. (FOX Carolina) - A fidget toy designed and created in the Upstate was one of the winners at the 25th annual Toy of the Year awards on Friday. Hexel by Plus-Plus USA, which is headquartered on Rutherford Road in Greenville, was named the 2025 Specialty Toy of the Year. Hexel is a flexible, portable set of six Plus-Plus pieces connected by a cord. Hexel by Plus-Plus, a Greenville-based toy maker, wins 2025 Specialty Toy of the Year. Greenville native Ryan Hamilton said the simple design of Plus-Plus toys challenges kids to find new ways to be creative. Inspired by fidget toys his kids played with, Hamilton experimented with Plus-Plus pieces until he came up with his own spin on a fidget toy in 2023.
